Consider the following statements about phyllotaxy :
(a) In alternate phyllotaxy, a single leaf arises at each node in alternate manner.
(b) In opposite phyllotaxy, a pair of leaves arise at each node and lie opposite to each other.
(c) In whorled phyllotaxy, more than two leaves arise at a node and form a whorl
(d) China rose shows opposite phyllotaxy.
Which statements are correct ?
"

options.text: All a, b, c and d
